description: Two coplanar unit-square faces sharing the edge x=1 (power 2 each), material 3. edgeOffsetsA/edgeAlphasA run along face A's edge 1 from (1,0,0) to (1,1,0); edgeOffsetsB/edgeAlphasB run along face B's edge 3 from (1,1,0) to (1,0,0) — the same physical profile in the opposite direction, so sewing must match them reversed.
